item.tib: shog dril chung pa dang po snyems thag gcod pa gcod kyi khrid yig
shog gril chung ba'i dang po snyems thag gcod pa'i gcod kyi khrid yig
item.coloph: bdag 'dra tshe dbang rig 'dzin gyis/ gzhan las che zab snyan rgyud 'di/ cha rkyen gcod kyi khrid 'di bstan/ rtog 'dzin can gyis gang zag rnams/ phyi dus yid smon ma bzhag par/ da lta mngon sum rjen pa ru/ brdug (sdug) bsngal rang grol ngo mtshar can/ 'di ltar nyams su len par gyis/ snyigs ma'i don du gter du sbas/ phyi rabs skal ldan snying gi bu/ sbas tshul thabs kyis 'gro don skyongs/ zag med bde bas nyams skyongs cig (shig)las ldan skyes bu'i 'khor gyis bskor/ 'brel mdzad (tshad) lam sna zin pa des/ phyir mi ldog par 'gyur bar 'byung / des kyang legs kyis ming la sbyin/ skal ldan de dang 'phrad par shog sa ma ya//
